title: Service Request #4: How Does the Grid in Phoenix Work?

sentences.en: A couple years ago, in the summer of 2023, I was in Phoenix doing some reporting.
sentences.zh: 几年前，也就是2023年的夏天，我在凤凰城做一些报道工作。

sentences.en: And that summer turned out to be the hottest on record.
sentences.zh: 而那个夏天成了有记录以来最热的一个夏天。

sentences.en: Not just for Phoenix, but for the entire planet.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对凤凰城，对整个地球来说都是如此。

sentences.en: September greeted millions of Americans with some of the hottest weather of the summer.
sentences.zh: 九月，数百万美国人迎来了那个夏天最炎热的天气。

sentences.en: Here in Phoenix, we are definitely used to this extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 在凤凰城，我们当然习惯了这种极端高温。

sentences.en: We are not used to experiencing 110-plus degree days this many days in a row.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不习惯连续这么多天经历超过110华氏度（约43摄氏度）的高温。

sentences.en: For 31 days, from the end of June until the end of July, temperatures exceeded 110 degrees.
sentences.zh: 从六月底到七月底，连续31天，气温都超过了110华氏度。

sentences.en: Saguaros were dropping dead from heat exposure.
sentences.zh: 巨人柱仙人掌因为受热而枯死。

sentences.en: People were spending days and then weeks inside.
sentences.zh: 人们不得不待在室内，先是几天，后来变成了几周。

sentences.en: Playgrounds were empty because the playground equipment would burn a kid's skin.
sentences.zh: 游乐场空无一人，因为游乐设施会烫伤孩子的皮肤。

sentences.en: The unrelenting sun high above Phoenix seems to be taking its toll on all living things.
sentences.zh: 凤凰城上空那无情的烈日似乎正在夺走所有生物的生命力。

sentences.en: And what struck me walking around the city during that time
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，走在城市中，最让我感到震惊的是

sentences.en: was how totally dependent Phoenix is on air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 凤凰城对空调的依赖程度有多深。

sentences.en: Everywhere you went, every building was cooled to the temperature of a refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 无论你走到哪里，每一栋建筑都被冷却得像冰箱一样。

sentences.en: And it was an enormous relief to walk into one of those crisp buildings
sentences.zh: 在外面忍受了酷热的空气后，走进这些凉爽的建筑里

sentences.en: after struggling through the hot air outside.
No matter where you live, the electrical grid is essential infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 无论你住在哪里，电网都是必不可少的基础设施。

sentences.en: But in Phoenix, it's not an overstatement to say that the city cannot exist without it.
sentences.zh: 但在凤凰城，说这座城市没有电网就无法生存，一点也不夸张。

sentences.en: If power goes out in the summertime, if all those air conditioners cannot run, people will die.
sentences.zh: 如果夏天停电，如果所有空调都无法运转，人们就会死亡。

sentences.en: Which made me wonder, how does the city know how much energy they'll need to provide
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁好奇，这座城市是如何知道在最炎热的夏日里

sentences.en: I'm Delaney Hall, and this is Service Request, a show from 99% Invisible and Campside Media.
sentences.zh: 我是德莱尼·霍尔，这是《服务请求》，一档来自《99%无形》和Campside Media的节目。

sentences.en: Each episode, we investigate a question about infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 每一集，我们都会探讨一个关于基础设施的问题，

sentences.en: the vast and hidden machinery of modern life.
sentences.zh: 即现代生活中那庞大而隐秘的机器。

sentences.en: We're looking at the pipes, the wires, the systems beneath your feet
sentences.zh: 我们关注的是你脚下的管道、电线和系统，

sentences.en: that you never really think about until they stop working.
sentences.zh: 在它们停止工作之前，你从未真正留意过它们。

sentences.en: Today, I'm submitting a service requeSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我要提交一份服务请求。

sentences.en: How does the grid in Phoenix actually work?
sentences.zh: 凤凰城的电网到底是如何运作的？

sentences.en: And the answer takes us into the enormous and complex machine that sends us our power.
sentences.zh: 答案将带我们走进那台为我们输送电力的庞大而复杂的机器。

sentences.en: So it's weirdly local, even though it's also incredibly immense.
sentences.zh: 所以它既有着奇特的地域性，又极其宏大。

sentences.en: It's often called the largest machine in the world.
sentences.zh: 它常被称为世界上最大的机器。

sentences.en: She wrote a book called The Grid.
sentences.zh: 她写了一本名为《电网》的书。

sentences.en: She's a cultural anthropologist who's studied the work of electrical engineers, regulators,
sentences.zh: 她是一位文化人类学家，研究过电气工程师、监管机构、

sentences.en: utility operators, and energy traders, trying to understand what they do.
sentences.zh: 公用事业运营商和能源交易员的工作，试图理解他们的所作所为。

sentences.en: And I'll be honest, right here at the start of this episode,
sentences.zh: 说实话，在这一集刚开始的时候，我得承认，

sentences.en: the grid is not easy to describe.
Electricity itself is not easy to describe.
The system that delivers it to our homes is not something that we really see.
sentences.zh: 将电输送到我们家中的系统并不是我们真正能看到的东西。

sentences.en: And it's meant to be illegible.
sentences.zh: 而且它注定是难以理解的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really, it's this, you don't have any access to a power plant.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它确实是这样，你根本无法接触到发电厂。

sentences.en: Like, you cannot, like, just go wander into a nuclear power plant,
sentences.zh: 比如，你不能随随便便走进一座核电站，

sentences.en: or to a coal-burning power plant, or even a hydroelectric dam.
sentences.zh: 或者燃煤电厂，甚至是一座水力发电大坝。

sentences.en: Instead, the way most of us interact with electricity is when we get our monthly utility bill.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们大多数人与电力的互动方式就是收到每月的电费账单。

sentences.en: So you just get this thing in the mail, and it doesn't seem to relate to anything.
sentences.zh: 你只是在邮件里收到这个东西，它看起来和任何事情都无关。

sentences.en: It's in some sort of unit that you have no idea what it actually means.
sentences.zh: 它用的是某种你根本不知道是什么意思的单位。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem to matter whatsoever what you turn on and what you turn off.
sentences.zh: 你开了什么或关了什么，似乎完全没有影响。

sentences.en: It's like going to the grocery store for the whole month,
sentences.zh: 这就像是整个月都在杂货店购物，

sentences.en: and then just getting the bill at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 然后月底才收到账单一样。

sentences.en: Did you buy pomegranates, and were they really expensive?
sentences.zh: 你买了石榴吗？它们真的很贵吗？

sentences.en: You don't know why your electricity bill goes up and down.
sentences.zh: 你不知道为什么你的电费账单会忽高忽低。

sentences.en: So it's illegible in every way.
sentences.zh: 所以它在各个方面都是难以理解的。

sentences.en: But we're going to do our best to make this whole system that generates and transmits our power more legible,
sentences.zh: 但我们将尽最大努力让这个发电和输电的整个系统变得更容易理解，

sentences.en: starting with where electricity comes from.
No matter how big of an electricity system you're talking about,
sentences.zh: 无论你谈论的电力系统有多大，

sentences.en: there's always more or less the same set of components.
sentences.zh: 其组成部分基本上都是一样的。
但让我们谈谈大型系统。

sentences.en: Power plants were originally mostly coal burning.
sentences.zh: 发电厂最初大多是燃煤的。

sentences.en: With time, the transition in the 2000s was toward natural gas.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，2000年代的转型方向是天然气。

sentences.en: But wind is a power plant.
sentences.zh: 但风能也是一种发电厂。

sentences.en: Solar panels are a power plant.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板也是一种发电厂。

sentences.en: And the electricity that flows to your house has to come from one of these sources.
sentences.zh: 流向你家的电力必须来自这些来源之一。

sentences.en: It could be a natural gas plant or a nuclear plant,
sentences.zh: 它可以是天然气发电厂或核电站，

sentences.en: a wind turbine, a solar array, a hydroelectric dam.
sentences.zh: 风力涡轮机、太阳能阵列或水力发电大坝。

sentences.en: Someone had to generate that electricity.
sentences.zh: 必须有人来产生这些电力。

sentences.en: Let's say you're on a coal system.
sentences.zh: 假设你使用的是煤炭系统。

sentences.en: So there's a coal burning factory somewhere, not too far away, within a couple hundred miles probably.
sentences.zh: 那么在某个地方有一家燃煤工厂，距离不太远，可能在几百英里之内。

sentences.en: And it's flash combusting coal powder, coal duSt.
sentences.zh: 它正在快速燃烧煤粉，也就是煤尘。

sentences.en: And there's a magnet stuck on the piece of a rotating piece of metal.
sentences.zh: 而且有一块磁铁粘在旋转的金属片上。

sentences.en: The coal dust is producing heat.
That steam is causing this thing to rotate.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽导致这个东西旋转。

sentences.en: And there's tiny little brushes on the outside.
And those brushes touch those magnets.
sentences.zh: 这些电刷接触那些磁铁。

sentences.en: And they produce what we call an alternating current.
sentences.zh: 它们产生了我们所说的交流电。

sentences.en: And that alternating current is sort of going, you can't see me,
sentences.zh: 那种交流电有点像是在……你看不见我，

sentences.en: but it's sort of like forward, back, forward, back, forward, back, forward, back, forward, back.
sentences.zh: 但它就像是向前、向后、向前、向后、向前、向后、向前、向后、向前、向后。

sentences.en: So it's not a constant stream.
sentences.zh: 所以它不是一股持续的流。

sentences.en: It's this motion, forward, back, forward, back, forward, back, forward, back,
sentences.zh: 它是这种运动，向前、向后、向前、向后、向前、向后、向前、向后，

sentences.en: of electrons that are jumping from atom to atom.
sentences.zh: 是电子在原子之间跳跃的运动。

sentences.en: Is this too much to tell?
No, I mean, honestly, this is like poetry.
sentences.zh: 不，说实话，这简直就像诗一样。

sentences.en: Those electrons are not moving steadily in one direction, like water flowing downhill.
sentences.zh: 那些电子并不是像水流下山坡那样朝着一个方向稳定移动。

sentences.en: Instead, as Gretchen said, they're jiggling back and forth, back and forth, 60 times a second.
sentences.zh: 相反，正如格雷琴所说，它们在来回抖动，每秒钟来回60次。

sentences.en: And that back and forth motion is what's traveling through the wire.
sentences.zh: 而那种来回的运动就是通过电线传播的东西。

sentences.en: What we have now are transmission lines, which are the really, really big lines
sentences.zh: 我们现在拥有的是输电线，也就是那些非常非常大的线路，

sentences.en: that children watch happily through the window on cross-country driving trips.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在长途驾车旅行时会透过窗户开心地看着它们。

sentences.en: I have been that kid, yes.
sentences.zh: 我曾经就是那个孩子，没错。
它们以自己的方式展现出一种美感。

sentences.en: They're striking in how they sort of hold their wires up.
sentences.zh: 它们支撑电线的方式非常引人注目。

sentences.en: They're a decorative piece of the grid in some ways, or the piece we're most likely to notice.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，它们是电网的装饰品，或者说是我们最容易注意到的部分。

sentences.en: Those big transmission lines carry high-voltage electricity over long distances.
sentences.zh: 那些大型输电线将高压电输送到很远的地方。

sentences.en: It's way more power than anyone would need to run their household appliances.
sentences.zh: 这比任何人运行家用电器所需的电力都要多得多。

sentences.en: It's enough power to kill an elephant, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这足以杀死一头大象。

sentences.en: And so the transmission lines eventually run into substations.
sentences.zh: 所以输电线最终会进入变电站。

sentences.en: Which is the piece we're least likely to notice, which is essentially a kind of gray,
sentences.zh: 这是我们最不容易注意到的部分，本质上是一种灰色的、
工业外观的、看起来像是用乐高积木搭出来的盒子。

sentences.en: Sometimes in a box, but it's often just a square of land with a fence around it.
sentences.zh: 有时是在盒子里，但通常只是一块围着栅栏的方形土地。

sentences.en: And what happens at the substation is that the electricity is stepped down in voltage.
sentences.zh: 而在变电站发生的事情是，电力的电压被降低了。

sentences.en: And it goes onto a totally different system, which is called the distribution network.
sentences.zh: 然后它进入了一个完全不同的系统，即配电网络。

sentences.en: And that's what goes into the house.
sentences.zh: 这就是进入家庭的部分。

sentences.en: Before it goes into the house, it's stepped down once again by a transformer,
sentences.zh: 在进入家庭之前，它会再次通过变压器降压，

sentences.en: which is often located on top of a utility pole outside your home.
sentences.zh: 变压器通常位于你家外面的电线杆顶端。

sentences.en: Again, this is for safety, so that an elephant-killing dose of electricity isn't flowing into your house.
sentences.zh: 同样，这是为了安全，这样就不会有足以杀死大象的电量流入你的家中。

sentences.en: So all of this stepping up is to move electricity long distance,
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些升压是为了远距离输电，

sentences.en: and stepping down is to keep it from being entirely lethal.
sentences.zh: 而降压则是为了防止它变得完全致命。

sentences.en: You can still kill yourself with it, but it's harder to do.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可能被它电死，但难度变大了。

sentences.en: The amazing thing about this system, the generation of power,
sentences.zh: 这个系统最神奇的地方在于，发电，

sentences.en: and then the movement of electricity through power lines to the home,
sentences.zh: 然后通过电线将电力输送到家中，

sentences.en: is that it happens incredibly faSt.
Electricity is always very, very fresh.
sentences.zh: 电力总是非常、非常新鲜的。

sentences.en: If you flip on your light switch or turn on your air conditioner about a minute before,
sentences.zh: 如果你在打开电灯开关或空调前大约一分钟，

sentences.en: that was a piece of coal.
Or coal duSt. That tends to be what we burn.
sentences.zh: 或者煤尘。那往往是我们燃烧的东西。

sentences.en: Or a drop of water, or a gust of wind, right?
sentences.zh: 或者是一滴水，或是一阵风，对吧？
这是一个非常快速的系统。

sentences.en: And it will go simultaneously anywhere it's called.
sentences.zh: 而且它会同时流向任何需要它的地方。

sentences.en: And we call that a sink.
So if you turn on your air conditioner,
all of the electricity in the system will say,
sentences.zh: 系统中的所有电力都会说，

sentences.en: And it will all come to you.
And then it comes, poof, and your air conditioner goes on.
sentences.zh: 然后它就来了，噗的一声，你的空调就启动了。

sentences.en: And here's another amazing thing about this system.
sentences.zh: 关于这个系统，还有另一件神奇的事情。

sentences.en: Historically, the grid has not had much storage capacity.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，电网并没有太多的存储容量。
这种情况正在迅速改变。

sentences.en: Grid-scale battery storage is a very hot field right now.
sentences.zh: 电网级电池存储现在是一个非常热门的领域。
这对可再生能源很重要。

sentences.en: But for most of the grid's history,
sentences.zh: 但在电网历史的大部分时间里，

sentences.en: electricity has typically been consumed almost the instant that it's produced.
sentences.zh: 电力通常在产生后的瞬间就被消耗掉了。
正如格雷琴所说，它是新鲜的。

sentences.en: And it makes sense to do it that way.
If you can deliver electricity on demand,
sentences.zh: 如果你能按需提供电力，

sentences.en: it doesn't really make sense to spend billions of dollars building giant batteries to store it.
sentences.zh: 花数十亿美元建造巨大的电池来储存它其实并没有意义。

sentences.en: It would be like running a restaurant and deciding to build a massive warehouse to stash the meals
sentences.zh: 这就好比经营一家餐馆，却决定建造一个巨大的仓库来囤积餐点，

sentences.en: when you could just cook them to order instead.
sentences.zh: 而你本可以按订单现做。

sentences.en: This metaphor doesn't totally work because electricity doesn't go bad like food,
sentences.zh: 这个比喻并不完全贴切，因为电力不会像食物那样变质，

sentences.en: But when you're delivering electricity on demand,
sentences.zh: 但是当你按需输送电力时，

sentences.en: the grid has to stay in perfect balance.
sentences.zh: 电网必须保持完美的平衡。

sentences.en: Meaning the amount of power being generated has to match the amount being used,
sentences.zh: 这意味着发电量必须与用电量相匹配，

sentences.en: pretty much exactly every second of every day.
sentences.zh: 几乎是一天中每一秒都要如此。

sentences.en: Because what's really being maintained is that precise frequency of 60 back-and-forth cycles per second.
sentences.zh: 因为真正需要维持的是每秒60次往复循环的精确频率。

sentences.en: Forward, back, forward, back, forward, back.
sentences.zh: 正向、反向，正向、反向，正向、反向。

sentences.en: That frequency of 60 hertz synchronizes every power plant,
sentences.zh: 这60赫兹的频率使每一座发电厂、

sentences.en: every transformer, and every home on the grid.
sentences.zh: 每一个变压器以及电网上的每一户家庭保持同步。
如果需求突然超过供应，

sentences.en: the frequency drops and the whole system gets out of whack.
sentences.zh: 频率就会下降，整个系统就会失控。

sentences.en: Cascading failures can knock out the grid entirely.
sentences.zh: 连锁故障可能会导致整个电网瘫痪。

sentences.en: That's why the supply of electricity must always meet the demand.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么电力供应必须始终满足需求。

sentences.en: Not too much, not too little.
But here's what makes this whole system even more complicated.
sentences.zh: 但让整个系统变得更加复杂的是这一点。

sentences.en: The grid isn't just one power plant serving one city.
sentences.zh: 电网不仅仅是一家发电厂服务一座城市。
它是一个庞大的集体项目。

sentences.en: An interconnected system that stretches across huge distances
sentences.zh: 一个横跨巨大距离的互联系统，

sentences.en: with many power plants and many utilities,
sentences.zh: 拥有许多发电厂和许多公用事业公司，

sentences.en: all trying to balance supply and demand in real time.
sentences.zh: 都在实时尝试平衡供需。

sentences.en: In the U.S., there are actually three grids.
sentences.zh: 在美国，实际上有三个电网。

sentences.en: The eastern grid, the Texas grid,
sentences.zh: 东部电网、德克萨斯电网，

sentences.en: and this is the grid that matters most for Phoenix,
sentences.zh: 而这对凤凰城来说最重要的电网是，

sentences.en: It stretches from western Canada down to Mexico
sentences.zh: 它从加拿大西部一直延伸到墨西哥，

sentences.en: and from the Pacific coast to the Rocky Mountains and beyond.
sentences.zh: 从太平洋沿岸一直延伸到落基山脉及更远的地方。

sentences.en: The western grid includes coal plants and solar farms
sentences.zh: 西部电网包括燃煤电厂、太阳能农场

sentences.en: and it ties together dozens and dozens of utilities
sentences.zh: 它将数十家公用事业公司连接在一起，

sentences.en: The thing to understand is that the grid is not just physical infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 要理解的是，电网不仅仅是物理基础设施。

sentences.en: It's an immense web of social, political, and economic relationships.
sentences.zh: 它是一个由社会、政治和经济关系构成的巨大网络。

sentences.en: There are deals at every possible level.
sentences.zh: 在每一个可能的层面上都有交易。

sentences.en: There's companies that are making deals for electricity across that space.
sentences.zh: 有公司在这一空间内进行电力交易。

sentences.en: So, you have different business models,
sentences.zh: 所以，你有不同的商业模式，
你有不同的公用事业公司，

sentences.en: and you have a set of federal regulations,
The fact that it works at all is just completely phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 它竟然能正常运作，这简直太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Within the western grid is Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 在西部电网内的是亚利桑那州的凤凰城。

sentences.en: And a central piece of Phoenix's relationship with the larger grid
sentences.zh: 而凤凰城与更大电网关系的核心部分

sentences.en: is a utility called the Salt River Project, or SRP.
sentences.zh: 是一家名为盐河工程（SRP）的公用事业公司。

sentences.en: When you flip on your air conditioner in Phoenix,
